description: How to watch a game in the UK: the confirmed TV channel, or "TBC" when none is announced, or "not shown live in the UK" for a Saturday 3pm Premier League game; plus the radio commentary line. Give a match ("Arsenal v Chelsea", "Man City vs Real Madrid") or just a club for its next game. UK only: it does not cover other countries' broadcasters.

club.description: Or a club, for its next game.

match.description: A game, e.g. "Liverpool v Man Utd". The home side first if known; the next meeting is used.

timezone.description: Optional IANA time zone for an extra local kick-off time, e.g. "America/New_York". UK time is always included.

name: where_to_watch
title: Where to watch (UK)
